title: ThirdFans
tagline: ThirdFans is a decentralized and transparent platform that provides creators with greater control over their content and revenue streams
description: The rise of non-fungible tokens (NFTs) and blockchain technology has led to the emergence of Web3, which is an entirely new approach to the internet that emphasizes decentralization, transparency, and user ownership. This technology has the potential to revolutionize the way we interact with content and creators.
how_its_made: This project is made using next js and design using tailwind. The smart contract is created with solidity. The token that is used for creating the NFT is the ERC-1155.  This means that a single contract can manage multiple tokens of different types, which can provide advantages such as improved efficiency and lower gas costs.
